title: 第273章 卡西姆的盘算
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

土耳其，迪亚巴克尔。

第2集团军驻地，一栋三层灰白小楼内。

卡西姆坐在宽大的真皮办公椅上，手里夹着一根粗壮的雪茄，青烟在指尖缭绕。

副官巴克站在办公桌前，低着头，手里拿着一份刚打印出来的通讯日志。

“还是没有动静？”

卡西姆出声打破了屋内的沉默。

“是的，将军。”

巴克翻开日志。

“从昨天晚上开始，鬣狗的卫星通讯设备就彻底断线了。”

“我们尝试了所有备用频道，都没有任何回应。”

“雅利安呢？”

卡西姆把雪茄放进嘴里，用力吸了一口。

“也失联了。”

“我们安插在巴扎尔甘的几个外围线人汇报，雅利安昨天在别墅里遭人绑架。”

“警察局那边封锁了整个巴扎尔甘，最后还是没抓到人。”

卡西姆吐出一口浓郁的烟气，抬头看着巴克。

“两个人，同一时间，在同一个地方，全都没了消息。”

他从椅子上站起身，走到墙边挂着的巨幅军事地图前。

手指停在地图上靠近边境线的一个小红点上。

那个红点，正是巴扎尔甘。

“巴克，你觉得这世上有这么巧的事儿吗？”

“将军的意思是……”

“鬣狗这次去巴扎尔甘，唯一的任务就是去查那个假死的华国人。”

卡西姆转过身，夹着雪茄的手指了指巴克。

“雅利安是他的接头人，负责给他提供掩护和情报支持。”

“现在，去查人的没了，负责接应的也没了。”

卡西姆冷笑出声。

“这恰恰说明一件事儿。”

“那个华国人，大概率就在巴扎尔甘！”

“而且，鬣狗和雅利安肯定是查到了什么关键线索，但最终暴露，所以才会相继失联。”

巴克听完这个分析，略显担心的道。

“将军，鬣狗实力不弱，雅利安更是海关缉私局的局长，明面上不止有一支队伍，还控制着巴扎尔甘的地下势力。”

“但……”

他停顿了一下。

“据反应回来的情况。”

“不止鬣狗和雅利安断了联系，巴扎尔甘的地下势力也重新洗牌。”

“‘黑狼帮’直接被灭。”

“如果这些真是都是那个华国人干的，那对方的实力可不弱。”

“很正常！”

卡西姆猛地打断了巴克的话，脸上的表情非但没有愤怒，反而透出几分狂热。

Page (1/3)

Diyarbakir, Türkiye.

The 2nd Army Group is stationed in a three-story gray and white building.

Kasim sat on a large leather office chair, holding a thick cigar in his hand, green smoke lingering on his fingertips.

Adjutant Buck stood in front of his desk, head lowered, holding a freshly printed communications log in his hand.

"Still no movement?"

Qasim spoke up, breaking the silence in the room.

"Yes, General."

Buck opened the journal.

"Since last night, Hyena's satellite communication equipment has been completely disconnected."

"We tried all the backup channels and got no response."

"Where's Aryan?"

Qasim put the cigar into his mouth and took a long drag.

"Also lost contact."

"Several outside informants we installed in Bazargan reported that Aryan was kidnapped in the villa yesterday."

"The police station cordoned off the entire Bazargan, but no one was arrested in the end."

Kasim exhaled a puff of thick smoke and looked up at Buck.

"Two people, at the same time, in the same place, no news about them."

He stood up from his chair and walked to the huge military map hanging on the wall.

His finger rested on a small red dot on the map near the border.

That red dot is Bazargan.

"Buck, do you think there are such coincidences in this world?"

"The general means..."

"The hyena's only mission when going to Bazargan this time is to investigate the Chinese who faked his death."

Kasim turned around and pointed at Buck with the finger holding his cigar.

"Aryan is his contact person and is responsible for providing him with cover and intelligence support."

"Now, there is no one to check people, and there is no one responsible for responding."

Kasim sneered.

"That just means one thing."

"That Chinese guy is most likely in Bazargan!"

"Moreover, Hyena and Aryan must have found some key clues, but they were eventually exposed, so they lost contact one after another."

After hearing this analysis, Buck said slightly worried.

"General, the hyenas are not weak. Aryan is the director of the Customs Anti-Smuggling Bureau. He has more than one team on the surface, and he also controls Bazargan's underground forces."

"But..."

He paused.

"According to the feedback."

"Not only have hyenas cut off contact with Aryan, Bazargan's underground forces have also been reshuffled."

"The 'Black Wolf Gang' was immediately destroyed."

"If all this is really done by the Chinese, then the other party's strength is not weak."

"It's normal!"

Kasim interrupted Buck abruptly, and instead of being angry, the expression on his face revealed a bit of fanaticism.
